nodes.label: Distilling Expert Judgment at Scale
nodes.author: Goldfarb, Hall, Fisher, Salam, Wilde
nodes.rationale: Methodology for encoding expert reasoning into automated evaluation systems that operate at scale, grounded in cognitive science of expertise.

nodes.label: Editorial Standards Development
nodes.rationale: Process: extracting generalizable evaluation standards from expert interviews through structured elicitation adapted from cognitive task analysis.

nodes.label: Source Quality Evaluation
nodes.rationale: Application domain: evaluating citation sources on authority and appropriateness, achieving expert-level agreement (α=0.83 test, F1=0.81 AI judge).

nodes.label: Neutrality Evaluation
nodes.rationale: Application domain: assessing whether information is presented without implicit political framing, achieving expert agreement (α=0.72 test, F1=0.86 AI judge).

nodes.label: Krippendorff's α Inter-Rater Reliability
nodes.rationale: Measurement instrument: accounts for chance agreement, supports binary and multi-category labels, used to validate both human and AI judge reliability.
